Core Focus Areas
Arjo focuses on institutional and hospital-based equipment rather than body-worn monitors. Their main product lines include:
MarketsandMarkets
Patient Handling:
Patient lifts, ceiling lifts, and transfer sheets.
Medical Beds & Surfaces:
Hospital beds and pressure injury prevention mattresses.
Hygiene & Disinfection:
Specialized bathing systems and flusher-disinfectors.
VTE Prevention:
Flowtron active compression systems for deep vein thrombosis prevention.
Diagnostics:
Fetal and vascular assessment monitors (via their Huntleigh subsidiary), which are stationary or handheld clinical devices rather than wearables.

Arjo
does not make consumer or remote-monitoring wearables
like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or sleep trackers. Arjo is a global medical device supplier focused on patient handling, medical beds, hygiene systems, and venous thromboembolism (VTE) prevention.
ArjoHuntleigh
What Arjo Makes
Patient Handling:
Floor lifts, ceiling lifts, and repositioning aids.
Medical Beds & Surfaces:
Support surfaces and pressure injury prevention gear.
Hygiene & Bathing:
Height-adjustable tubs and shower systems.
VTE Prevention:
Flowtron active compression systems.
Diagnostics (via Huntleigh):
Vascular assessment and fetal monitoring tools.
ArjoHuntleigh
Common Health Wearables
If you are looking for personal consumer or remote health tech instead, those devices are made by other brands:
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Abbott (FreeStyle Libre) or Dexcom.
Smartwatches & Wearable ECGs:
Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch, or Fitbit.
Sleep Trackers:
Oura Ring, Amazfit Helio Ring, or Whoop.
